_why: The single source of question ids, shared by both measurement tiers. The Python tier (tools/reach.py) owns AVAILABILITY - is the fact in any payload this seat may legally fetch. The browser tier (app/sim/reach.js) owns COST - how many taps it takes to get it onto a screen. They merge on `id`, so the ids live here rather than being written twice and drifting. Each tier asserts at startup that it implements exactly these ids and fails loudly on drift; a question silently implemented by neither would read as 'reachable' in the merge.
_merge_rule: reachable = available AND (taps is not null). Availability is a necessary condition and a veto. available-but-not-reachable is the headline finding class: the data is there and the UI cannot get to it. not-available-but-taps-reported means the browser probe is broken, and that disagreement is itself a finding.
